description: This Java source file defines the Renderer class responsible for formatting and generating an HTML bug report. It processes bug report data and templates to produce a comprehensive HTML report outlining various aspects such as process and thread states, logs, ANRs, and VM traces.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: A class that formats a bug report as HTML and writes the output to a file. It constructs a hierarchical data structure representing various components of the bug report, such as process states, threads, logs, and traces, and renders this data using the JSilver templating engine.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method that loads the template, builds the hierarchical data, and writes the formatted HTML report to the specified output file.

methods.name: makeHdf
methods.description: Builds the hierarchical data structure (HDF) for the bug report, calling subordinate functions for different report sections.

methods.name: makeAnrHdf
methods.description: Builds the HDF for an ANR (Application Not Responding) report segment.

methods.name: makeVmTracesHdf
methods.description: Builds HDF for VM traces and sorts processes by likelihood.

methods.name: makeTriageHdf
methods.description: Builds the triage panel HDF, including process and thread information, deadlocks, and interesting processes.

methods.name: cloneAndFilter
methods.description: Clones and filters process snapshots, removing already visited threads for hierarchical display.

methods.name: makeCpuUsageSnapshotHdf
methods.description: Builds HDF for a CPU usage snapshot.

methods.name: makeCpuUsageHdf
methods.description: Builds HDF for a CPU usage entity; (Implementation is empty in provided code).

methods.name: makeProcessSnapshotHdf
methods.description: Constructs HDF representation of a process snapshot including its threads.

methods.name: makeThreadSnapshotHdf
methods.description: Builds HDF for thread snapshot details, including state, attributes, and stack frames.

methods.name: buildFunctionName
methods.description: Helper to concatenate package, class, and method names into a fully qualified function name.

methods.name: makeStackFrameSnapshotHdf
methods.description: Builds HDF for a stack frame, handling different frame types (native, kernel, Java).

methods.name: sortProcesses
methods.description: Sort processes according to relevance, prioritizing the main or blamed process.

methods.name: sortThreads
methods.description: Sorts threads within processes by interest level and name.

methods.name: makeLogcatHdf
methods.description: Creates HDF segments for logcat lines, both interesting lines and the raw log output.

methods.name: makeLogcatLineHdf
methods.description: Creates HDF for individual log lines with detailed information.
